set.body:
Defect: D3/D4. SourceBundle.of (source.scala:1018) is public and DOES accept SourceKind.AnnotationTable -- but it has zero callers and demands a PresentationAxis, and every axis constructor is kind-specific: textCharacter (WrittenText), editionPlayback (FilmEdition), inventedEditionPlayback (refuses every kind, :652-672). So no axis for a non-edition kind can be minted and `of` can never be satisfied. Consequence today: FilmFestivalRecallMapping.scala:148-168 forges EditionId('filmfestival-annotation-<sha>-<part>') into SourceBundle.filmEdition for a corpus with NO ADMITTED VIDEO, its own Scaladoc stating 'This is deliberately not a film edition'. The type says FilmEdition; the comment says it is not one. Friends would have to tell the same lie.

Do: DECIDE and record in the ADR: either add a SourceBundle.annotationTable constructor that mints a lawful non-edition axis, or keep forging and rename the construct so the type stops asserting something false. Do not leave it implicit.

Tests: If the constructor is added: FilmFestival and Friends both stop forging, and a test asserts no EditionId is minted for a corpus with no admitted media.

Exit: Either a lawful annotation axis exists, or the ADR records why forging continues and what the name now says.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S0 D3/D4; S3 P3
set.title: intake P3 DECISION: a lawful axis for a timed annotation table, or rename the lie
